name: Kendo-ComfyUI-H3 V4 beta.3
readme:
## Kendo V4 beta.3

V3-compatible MiniMax H3 video generation plus official MiniMax H3 Image INT8 still-image generation/editing. No Singularity model and no latent-upscale nodes.

- **Page** — port `3000`: Video H3 and H3 Image modes
- **Claude MCP** — port `3001`: one public HTTPS URL, secret path, no IP lock. It exposes `kendo_generate` and `kendo_image_generate` plus their status tools.
- **ComfyUI** — port `8188`
- **JupyterLab** — port `8888`

H3 Image uses the native ComfyUI workflow (ComfyUI 0.45.0), INT8 diffusion/text encoder, Euler/simple, CFG 1 and fixed 6 steps. It supports text-to-image and editing with up to 16 image references, ratios from 1:1 through 3:1/1:3, and 1K, 2K, 4K or MAX up to 20 MP. MAX can approach an 8K long edge only on extreme aspect ratios. First launch downloads about 94 GB of video + image weights with resume and exact-size verification. Storage defaults are 200 GB container and 200 GB volume. SageAttention is runtime-detected for RTX 5090 / RTX PRO 6000 with Native fallback.
